### Parental Limits
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/parental-limits-one-year-devotions-for-men-august-23.html
Passage: Judges 13:5
Points:
- Manoah's wife was instructed to protect her unborn child's Nazirite consecration through her own diet and habits.
- Samson grew up in a home where godly parents carefully taught him the special calling on his life.
- As children grow into adulthood, parents inevitably face limits on how much they can control their decisions.
- Raising dedicated servants of God requires moving beyond authoritarian commands to personal example, winsome concern, and persevering prayer.

### Samson’s Miracle Birth Points to the Incarnate Word
Author: Davy Ellison
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/samsons-points-incarnate/
Passage: Judges 13:1-25
Points:
- Even when Israel did not cry out for help, God took the initiative to send a deliverer.
- Manoah’s persistent questioning illustrates how believers often doubt or overanalyze God's clear revelation instead of resting in His Word.
- Manoah’s wife showed spiritual wisdom by recognizing that God's acceptance of their sacrifice meant favor rather than death.
- Samson’s miraculous birth ultimately points beyond him to Jesus Christ, the true Savior and incarnate Word.

### Bible Pathway - March 27
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-mar-27-2013.html
Passage: Judges 13:24-25
Points:
- Samson was blessed by God and experienced the stirring of the Holy Spirit from an early age.
- Although raised by godly parents, Samson later compromised his calling by seeking self-centered desires among God's enemies.
- Samson's undisciplined life mirrored the unfaithfulness and moral compromise of Israel during the Judges era.
- Believers are called to live consecrated lives separated from worldly compromise, yielding fully to God's will.
- Samson's calling as a Nazirite from the womb foreshadows Jesus Christ, who perfectly obeyed the Father in all things.
